known_limited_prior_decisions.scope: Holding strategy; not cadence or experiment ratification

known_limited_prior_decisions.decision: Programmatic text capabilities deferred for headless Stage 3 only

decisions.subject: Review cadence and finite horizon
decisions.recommendation: Ratify monthly reviews on 2026-11-17 and 2026-12-17 with final owner checkpoint 2027-01-17, per Stage 2J; no automation.
decisions.required_record: Explicit approval or revised finite dates, reviewer effort limit, start/end and missed-review/extension policy.

decisions.subject: Named accountable roles
decisions.recommendation: Name Rust/Windows maintainer, independent evidence reviewer, human accessibility operator and project owner; verify willing availability.
decisions.required_record: Actual names or explicit role identifiers accepted by owner, responsibilities and independence; no assignment from local account or Git identity.

decisions.subject: Supported configurations and accessibility modalities
decisions.recommendation: Approve exact Windows editions/build ranges, architectures, keyboard layouts/languages, DPI/monitors, high contrast/motion profiles, Narrator versions and other declared AT; distinguish entry and release coverage.
decisions.required_record: Versioned support matrix and unavailable mandatory cases, operator availability, configuration-change consent if any, resource/geometry thresholds. No existing host sample qualifies all Windows 10/11.

decisions.subject: Product value of a limited noneditable catalog
decisions.recommendation: Decide whether browsing without search or shell activation warrants a qualification effort; otherwise retain headless scope.
decisions.required_record: Actual product-value decision and exact candidate scope/design exception; existing approved grid/search catalog is not silently replaced.

decisions.subject: Authorize an isolated experiment with bounded scope
decisions.recommendation: Only consider a fixed nonpersonal single-selection list with separate Launch/Refresh/status in an ordinary window after provider prerequisites; no actual application launch initially.
decisions.required_record: Explicit phase approval, allowed paths/versions, named reviewer/operator, start/stop dates or engineer-hour/run cap, queue/metadata/resource limits, fixture permission separately for B, stop/resume criteria. No authority recorded yet.

decisions.subject: Approved upstream resolution of label/container scrolling gaps
decisions.recommendation: Require exact stable published provider source proving LabeledBy and container ScrollPattern; approve any isolated dependency experiment separately and verify native runtime properties/methods.
decisions.required_record: Exact cooperating versions/revisions/checksums, source/API/license/MSRV audit and approved adoption scope; no label removal, ScrollItem substitution or silent pagination.

decisions.subject: Triggers for reconsidering Options B or C
decisions.recommendation: Owner checkpoint, rejected adequate upstream candidate or explicit unacceptable waiting cost can trigger a new decision; never automatic adoption.
decisions.required_record: Explicit research authorization, maintenance owner/budget, bounded scope and stop gates; no custom widget/native-control/framework alternative approved.
